comment: Mantling slice 1 (docs/design/MANTLING.md section 11, designer answers 11.6; docs/port/MANTLING_SLICE1_REPORT.md). Read by MantleRules::GetConfig (Source/CodexTactics/Public/Characters/MantleRules.h) at game start; FMantleConfig's defaults mirror this file (test CodexTactics.Characters.Mantle.TuningFileMirrorsDefaults). The height classes' nominal / tolerance are NOT here: they come from Content/Data/LevelGen/obstacle_heights.json (the level generator's standard; wall_no_traverse.min_cm = the traversal ceiling). Here: the action per class (destination top / over, enabled, marked_edge_only = only obstacles tagged CodexMantleEdge, handled_by vault = the existing vault takes it), the clip table (retargeted root-motion copies; rise / forward = the copy's measured root track, Saved/Logs/setup_mantle_animation.txt; the four NEEDS_REVIEW clips stay out, designer Q4) and the params. Distances cm, times s. Run-up (designer Q2 = A): a run clip only when he is already running and the face lies inside the run clip's forward-warp window (max_forward_warp); else he stops and the standing clip plays; it starts when the face is no farther than the clip's own run-up (its hand contact's distance in its track, x1.05; B17-3) and the first warp window puts the hands on the lip (a clip whose hands slide over the top: its slowest hand frame at the ledge height, align.slide_speed_cm_s). Over a fence (B17-4): start_cm = the face's distance at the clip's hand plant on the fence (HighFenceVault male: plant hand 190.3 cm ahead of the root - grip 8 = 182, MantleFenceRouteSmoke 2026-11-17; female scaled by her forward travel = 174): the click base and the path start the clip there, and the first warp window puts the hands on the fence's near lip. On a top he crouches (Q3). The hover ghost (B17-2, designer option A) shows the clicked climb clip frozen ghost.pose_fraction through its hand hold on the lip, at the face. A knockdown or a hit of at least heavy_hit_damage cancels the climb (Q5): he drops back to the base. links.*: the path links (an order path over an eligible obstacle mantles by itself: the operative the player commands in Solo, and since R17-1 the formation leader; formation follows never take them). squad.* (R17-1, designer 2026-11-17, MANTLING.md 6.4): a group order that needs a climb (formation: the leader + his followers; Solo: the box selection) climbs in turns with the ladder queue's rules (TTraversalQueue: one holder, FIFO line, the ladder's spot rule queue_first_cm + queue_spacing_cm x place out from the face): leader first, then the formation / selection order; each man on his own lane of the face (lane_spacing_cm apart, landings min_landing_gap_cm apart); the waiters stand at the base facing out (the threat first, fanned wait_fan_deg, never more than wait_max_off_deg off the outward look); the man up covers the far side / the threat; the next goes next_delay_s after the previous one is up; a turn gives up after turn_timeout_s; members farther than join_radius_cm keep their orders. Console Codex.Mantle.Squad 0 = before R17-1.
